note: A move the robot side stops as blocked is sent once more at this fraction of its speed (tools/util/arm.py). Between 0 and 1: 0.5 is half as fast, 1 the same speed again, 0 no second try.
note_safe_mode: safe_mode: the gripper only points straight down and only travels in straight lines (up, across, down); what cannot be reached that way is refused as too far (tools/util/safe.py). carry_height: metres above the table the tool point travels at; straight down the arm reaches no higher than about 0.07.
